bayesian_learning.utils.export.export_categorical_from_bif(bif_file: str, output_prefix: str)¶

Helper method to load a BIF file and export its graphics and CPTs.

bayesian_learning.utils.export.export_categorical_results(bn: BayesNet, output_prefix: str)¶

Exports a Categorical BayesNet. - Saves the native BIF format - Saves a graphical plot (PNG) - Saves the CPTs to a readable text file

Exports a SEM Result. - Saves the Adjacency Matrix to CSV - Saves a graphical plot (PNG)

Utility function to plot a networkx DiGraph and save it to a file using PyDot.
